overridesNotes.fast-uri: GHSA-9j5g-h5jm-jm3g (dependabot #47): ajv@8.20.0 (via schema-utils <- webpack, used by @next/mdx and packages/wgsl's webpack devDependency) depends on fast-uri@^3.0.1 and resolved to the vulnerable 3.1.4. Raised the floor from the pre-existing ^3.1.4 override to ^3.1.5 (the patched release); still within ajv's declared range.
overridesNotes.postcss: Dependabot #20/#44/#45/#46: next@16.2.12 (already npm-latest, used by apps/docs) and next@15.5.22 (examples/next-wgsl) both hard-pin an exact, unpatched `postcss: 8.4.31` as a direct dependency of next itself -- bumping next further does not change this pin. Overriding forces every instance to >=8.5.23 (the version already used elsewhere in the tree via vite).
overridesNotes.sharp: Dependabot #25 (libvips CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591): next's `sharp: ^0.34.5` optional dependency (same next versions as above) is below the 0.35.0 patched release upstream. Overriding to ^0.35.0 exceeds next's own declared range; verified sharp's 0.35.0 breaking changes (Node >=20.9 floor, AVIF quality metric, removed already-deprecated props) don't affect next's narrow resize/format usage.
